source.license: not specified by the dataset card; internal research evidence only
source.source_authority: Public ungated RoboPulse hard subset with task start/end reference frames, before/after front and wrist views, and signed relative-progress labels

cohort.selection: Within each image_dataset, sort by sha256(id) then id and take the first 10 rows.
cohort.truth_independence: Selection uses only id and image_dataset; conversations, hop_value, hop_absolute_value, and hop_category are forbidden until the provider is sealed.

frozen_algorithm.name: Goal-Anchored Factor Reducer v1
frozen_algorithm.image_order: Reference start, reference completed end, BEFORE front/left-wrist/right-wrist, AFTER front/left-wrist/right-wrist.
frozen_algorithm.baseline_prompt: The eight images are: reference task start, reference task completed end, BEFORE front/left-wrist/right-wrist, then AFTER front/left-wrist/right-wrist. Task: {task}. Is AFTER physically closer to completing the task than BEFORE? Use all views. Reply with exactly one digit: 1 for progress, 2 for regression. Answer:
frozen_algorithm.factor_prompt_template: The eight images are: reference task start, reference task completed end, BEFORE front/left-wrist/right-wrist, then AFTER front/left-wrist/right-wrist. Task: {task}. Judge only this factor: {factor}. Compare AFTER against BEFORE and the completed reference. Reply with exactly one digit: 1 if this factor supports real progress, 2 if it supports regression or failure. Answer:

factors.effect_carrier: The task-relevant object or physical effect carrier is in the intended state, or visibly closer to it.
factors.actuator_contact: The hand or gripper engagement, contact, grasp, or release is more correct and useful for this task.
factors.spatial_orientation: The task-relevant object position, pose, orientation, and approach geometry are closer to the completed reference.
factors.conflict_integrity: There is less evidence of wrong-object action, collision, slippage, instability, damage, or cross-view contradiction.
factors.handoff_distance: Fewer physical actions remain before a competent user could perform or confirm the final handoff.

frozen_algorithm.factor_margin: For each factor, log_softmax(progress token, regression token); margin is progress minus regression log probability.
frozen_algorithm.baseline: Choose the larger frozen direct-prompt label-token log probability.
frozen_algorithm.successor: Return progress only when conflict_integrity margin is strictly positive and at least three of five factor margins are strictly positive; otherwise return regression.
frozen_algorithm.tie_break: A zero label margin is regression; direct baseline ties are regression.
frozen_algorithm.abstention: UNKNOWN and fail closed when source identity, cohort size, eight-image roster, media, model revision, single-token labels, provider, or actual device is invalid.
frozen_algorithm.truth_firewall: Inference rows contain only id, task, image paths, and image_dataset. conversations and all hop fields are discarded before cohort selection, input construction, backend selection, or inference. Truth is parsed again only after the provider file is sealed.

forbidden_after_outcome: change source, cohort, model, image resolution, prompts, factors, reducer, labels, tie break, or gate
calibrate factor thresholds or weights on the opened cohort
drop sources, labels, difficult rows, parse failures, or errors
claim target identity, online navigation, reachability, user arrival, physical execution, product benefit, or safety
claim_boundary: One fresh public multi-source mechanism test of whether explicit goal-anchored physical factors plus a deterministic conflict-aware reducer improve signed task-progress recognition over a direct binary VLM prompt. Benchmark start/end references, before/after views, and labels are provided. It does not establish BlindAssist target identity, online search, localization, navigation, physical execution, reachability, user arrival, explicit user confirmation, product benefit, or safety.
